root_cause: Continuous improvement, technology discovery and portal intelligence existed, but lacked one explicit contract joining autonomous technical evolution, security, cross-platform optimization, external benchmarks and calibrated customer foresight.
prevention: All future technical discovery and customer forecasting must share provenance, benchmarks, confidence, freshness, uncertainty, security non-degradation, champion-challenger evaluation, rollback identity and production readback.
completion_rule: LIVE_BEWEZEN requires protected delivery plus terminal green production readback and applicable security/code-analysis evidence on the canonical main lineage.

skills_writeback.rule: A foresight/autonomy change is not complete at merge or deploy. Preserve one obligation lineage, require exact-head protected delivery, terminal production readback, applicable security/code-analysis, ancestry/current-state verification, then write LIVE_BEWEZEN and reusable prevention back to shared learning.
